cause: paxgate's prompt asked for the check at /tmp/check_task.py written with a heredoc; the model used write_file, which refuses any path outside /workspace (FileWriteError: path traversal), and the subprocess sandbox rewrites /tmp in run_command to a per-sandbox directory. 156 of about 200 check runs in colab_r1b failed with No such file; the frozen check passed at the end in 1 of 127 episodes. The same design flaw is in paxgate_seq; colab_r2a (paxgate replicate and paxgate_seq) was stopped after about 10 minutes and is not used.
fix: paxgate2 and paxgate2_seq (Personaxis 2.3.0) keep the check at .git/pax_check.py, written with write_file at a relative path and run with PYTHONPATH=. python3 .git/pax_check.py; files under .git/ never enter the patch.
title: Round 1 gate could not run its check: /tmp is outside the workspace for write_file and rewritten in shell commands
